original_test_intent: Preserve a requirement to validate an unspecified cable associated with an I2C path, without choosing between logical endpoint reachability, physical assembly, conductor continuity/insulation or signal-integrity acceptance.
original_method: No method is authorized until Engineering identifies the harness and both endpoints and defines the required logical, physical and electrical checkpoints with their separate criteria, safe power state and recovery. A fresh case review must then select the capability class and operation.
manual_activity: Cabling, platform-management and hardware owners must identify the exact harness/endpoints and decide which logical, assembly, continuity, insulation and signal-quality checkpoints actually define this row.
required_inputs: For continuity/insulation: instrument, pin matrix and resistance limits
For signal integrity: measurement points, load/traffic state and timing/electrical limits
Distinct acceptance, abort and recovery for every required stage
safety_requirements: Do not infer endpoints or pinout from the generic Cable label
Do not scan a bus to discover the harness
Do not disconnect, reseat, back-probe or measure an energized unknown cable
Do not assume a downstream response proves every conductor or margin
Do not assume continuity proves protocol operation or ownership
Preserve endpoint, management, power and thermal evidence
Stop on pinout mismatch, short, endpoint loss, bus/power/thermal anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Record the unresolved cable identity and evidence modalities
Perform no I2C access, physical handling or instrument measurement
Do not reuse row-1808 endpoints or decision as target evidence
Require an approved stage matrix and fresh review
engineer_actions: Identify the exact cable and endpoint connectors
Choose logical, assembly, continuity/insulation and/or signal-integrity scope
Approve bus operations and/or physical instruments with limits
Define stage-specific acceptance, safe state and recovery
Request fresh review and own the eventual verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After approval, use a mapped BMC/OOB transaction matrix for logical reachability and separately use documented inspection, pin-to-pin/insulation or signal-integrity measurements only for the stages the owner requires.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents the generic Cable label from being silently converted into one preferred test modality.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Logical response, visual seating, DC continuity and dynamic signal quality each prove different properties; no one stage is automatically equivalent to the others.

project_override_considerations: The Wistron I2C rule applies only to a future logical stage. It does not define the harness or waive mechanical/electrical coverage. Project applicability must preserve all explicitly chosen stages and report any unexecuted coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved cable definition and fresh review
PN/revision, endpoints, connector references, pinout and routing
Stage matrix separating logical, visual, continuity/insulation and signal-integrity scope
If logical: exact BMC route, targets, transaction and responses
If physical/electrical: safe state, instrument/calibration, raw per-pin or waveform evidence and limits
Pre/post endpoint, BMC, power and thermal health
Abort/recovery audit and engineer verdict per stage

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master contains no contradictory statements; it is missing the cable identity and referenced method/criteria needed to establish the fundamental test modality.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Neither the target cable nor the operation and acceptance modality can be determined. Supplying ordinary project bus parameters would not decide whether logical reachability, physical assembly, continuity/insulation or signal integrity is required, so selecting a plan now would invent scope.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1828 Wistron-HW-00450-V002 Cable: exact harness PN/revision, endpoint boards/connectors, pinout/length/routing and whether acceptance requires logical BMC-I2C reachability, physical assembly, continuity/insulation, signal integrity or separately accepted stages; for each required stage provide route or instrument method, expected results/limits, safe power state, aborts and recovery, preserve Master TBD and require fresh review.

review_improvement: Separates four non-equivalent cable evidence modalities and refuses both a guessed bus probe and an unsupported manual-continuity classification until the target and acceptance scope are explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: A cable is not itself an addressable I2C target. A responder can prove that some path worked at one instant while leaving unused pins, retention, insulation or timing margin unverified; a continuity meter can prove conductors yet miss protocol ownership and dynamic integrity. Because the source names neither harness nor desired property, this ambiguity is irreducible until Engineering chooses the evidence stages.
